title: ArcBest Named AMP Best Trucking Company in Arkansas
summary: ArcBest was voted Best Trucking Company in Arkansas in AMP’s Best of 2026 Awards for the fifth consecutive year.
body_markdown:
## Arkansas readers recognize ArcBest for fifth consecutive year


ArcBest has been named[Best Trucking Company in Arkansas](https://armoneyandpolitics.com/amp-best-of-2026-arkansas/) in Arkansas Money & Politics' (AMP) Best of 2026 Awards, marking the fifth consecutive year the company has received this recognition. The awards highlight businesses, organizations and professionals across Arkansas through reader nominations and voting.


“We’re proud to call Arkansas home, and it means a lot to be recognized by people across our state,” said Seth Runser, ArcBest president and CEO. “For more than 100 years, we’ve built strong relationships by taking care of customers and delivering on our commitments. This recognition reflects the trust we’ve earned and the work our people do every day to provide a premium experience and help our customers succeed.”


Founded in Arkansas in 1923 as a local freight hauler, ArcBest has grown into an integrated logistics company serving more than 30,000 customers through a North American network with global reach. Today, ArcBest combines the reliability of asset-based capacity with the flexibility of our broad capacity network and technology to keep freight moving and help customers solve complex logistics challenges.
